issues.issue: The DRAM / NAND / HBM list is a generic memory-category bundle. NAND and HBM are not established by any inspected company-specific source.
issues.sourceNeeded: A Nanya-owned current product catalog or annual report identifying actual DRAM, NAND and/or HBM products; absence from an unrelated repository is not disproof.
